rows.grounds: third singular middle present of pra-jan

items.question: What arises when one knows the hidden true nature of that?
premises: knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness
that refers to the divine lord
items.inference: all-knowingness arises upon knowing the hidden true nature
uncertainties: exact referent of taṃ depends on prior context
compound gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ may imply deeper hidden reality
items.plain_english: Knowing that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
